description: This source file manages rbus subscriptions, including creating, adding, removing, loading, saving, and handling subscription lifecycle events. It includes functions for cache management, subscription comparison, and event handling in an RBus (Remote Bus) system.

classes.name: struct _rbusSubscriptions
classes.description: Main data structure managing a set of subscriptions, including handle, root element, component name, temporary directory, and list of subscriptions.

methods.name: int subscriptionKeyCompare(rbusSubscription_t * subscription,char const * listener,int32_t componentId,char const * eventName,rbusFilter_t filter,int32_t interval,int32_t duration,bool rawData)
methods.description: Compares a subscription with provided parameters to determine if they match based on listener, componentId, eventName, filter, interval, duration, and rawData.

methods.name: void subscriptionFree(void * p)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a subscription, including its instances, tokens, and other allocated fields.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_create(rbusSubscriptions_t * subscriptions,rbusHandle_t handle,char const * componentName,elementNode * root,const char * tmpDir)
methods.description: Initializes the subscriptions structure, setting handle, root element, component name, temporary directory, and loading cache.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_destroy(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions)
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates the subscriptions structure.

methods.name: rbusSubscription_t * rbusSubscriptions_addSubscription(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,char const * listener,char const * eventName,int32_t componentId,rbusFilter_t filter,int32_t interval,int32_t duration,bool autoPublish,elementNode * registryElem,bool rawData)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new subscription, generating its tokens, initializing fields, and saving cache.

methods.name: rbusSubscription_t * rbusSubscriptions_getSubscription(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,char const * listener,char const * eventName,int32_t componentId,rbusFilter_t filter,int32_t interval,int32_t duration,bool rawData)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing subscription matching the specified key parameters.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_removeSubscription(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,rbusSubscription_t * sub)
methods.description: Removes a specified subscription from the list and frees its resources.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_onSubscriptionCreated(rbusSubscription_t * sub,elementNode * node)
methods.description: Recursively processes the element tree to associate existing subscriptions with matching elements.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_onElementCreated(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,elementNode * node)
methods.description: Handles creation of new element instances, updating subscriptions accordingly.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_onElementDeleted(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,elementNode * node)
methods.description: Handles deletion of element instances, updating subscriptions accordingly.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_onTableRowAdded(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,elementNode * node)
methods.description: Wrapper to handle added table rows, invoking onElementCreated.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_onTableRowRemoved(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,elementNode * node)
methods.description: Wrapper to handle removed table rows, invoking onElementDeleted.

methods.name: pid_t rbusSubscriptions_getListenerPid(char const * listener)
methods.description: Extracts the process ID (PID) from the listener name.

methods.name: bool rbusSubscriptions_isProcessRunning(pid_t pid)
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is currently running.

methods.name: bool rbusSubscriptions_isListenerRunning(char const * listener)
methods.description: Determines if the listener process is active based on the listener name.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_loadCache(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions)
methods.description: Loads cached subscription data from a file into memory, reconstructing subscription objects.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_saveCache(rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions)
methods.description: Saves current subscriptions into a cache file for persistence.

methods.name: int _compareEventNameToElemName(char const * event,char const * elem)
methods.description: Compares event name and element name, allowing for wildcards and special {i} row template matching.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_resubscribeElementCache(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,char const * elementName,elementNode * el)
methods.description: Resubscribes to event elements based on cache matching, typically during reconnects or reloads.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_resubscribeRowElementCache(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,elementNode * rowNode)
methods.description: Resubscribes to row elements within a table, matching by event name prefix.

methods.name: void rbusSubscriptions_handleClientDisconnect(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusSubscriptions_t subscriptions,char const * listener)
methods.description: Handles client disconnects, unsubscribing and cleaning up subscriptions for a listener.
